content: {"episode_id":"ep-05110","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. The patient also has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), and prolonged monitoring is required to correlate the patient's symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. Shorter-duration monitoring cannot capture these intermittent, symptom-correlated events, making the ordered telemetry medically necessary. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial in light of the submitted clinical indication note supporting this service."}
